history.text: About four in five homes in Guyuk LGA speak Longuda; the town lies on the Numan–Biu road and has limestone deposits.

language.name: Longuda
language.note: Usually counted as an Adamawa language; Glottolog places the Tula-Longuda group under Gur.

summary.text: The Longuda are the people of Guyuk LGA in Adamawa State, where about four in five homes speak Longuda.

areas.note: 'Predominantly Longuda': 81% of homes surveyed. Share from a 2022-23 survey of displaced people quoted by Wikipedia, not a census.
